text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober and I are on our way<n>home from a
shrine, where she<n>prayed for help getting out of a
rut.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
That was a nice change of pace, but...<n>If a prayer
could fix everything, we'd<n>all be champions.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Thunk!

text_block_list.name: Little Girl
text_block_list.text: Waaaah! Owww!

text_block_list.name: Elementary School Boy
text_block_list.text: Are you okay?! Show me where it<n>hurts!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Oh no! I'm going to see if<n>everything's okay!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober jogs over to the<n>children and starts
treating the little<n>girl's wound. Before long, the girl
brightens up again.

text_block_list.name: Elementary School Boy
text_block_list.text: Thank you, miss!

text_block_list.name: Little Girl
text_block_list.text: Bye-bye!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: You're welcome. Bye-bye.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... Off they go. I'm glad it wasn't<n>anything
serious.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I was just thinking about how my<n>little brother and
sister will be their<n>age soon.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I don't see them much, so it's hard<n>to picture what
they'll be like.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
As their older sister, I can't let myself<n>get tripped
up over something like<n>this.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I have to be a good role model for my<n>siblings.
choice_data_list: You can do it. I believe in you.
You can do it. I believe in you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Ugh! That's not the kind of thing you<n>say out loud!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Haha. I don't think being the ideal<n>sister is going to
be that easy, though.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Let's head back. I feel like going for a<n>run!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Let's head back. I feel like going for a<n>run!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober seems to be in much<n>better spirits
after visiting the shrine!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Maybe I'm not even fit to be their<n>older sister.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I can't even pull myself out of this<n>rut...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Trainer? Is it all right if I go pray<n>again?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
On our way home from the shrine,<n>Mejiro Dober
keeps sighing and<n>remains in dismal spirits...
